# Total.js conventions

> How Total.js 5 applications are written: ES5 over ES6, Total.js prototypes and Tangular first, no imports from Node.js, pipe-separated action and schema names, explicit or action-declared routes, recognizable runtime/private/docs folders, MODS module access, existing storage and DATA queries, PostgreSQL scripts, native tests, CMS widgets and jComponent components loaded with COMPONENTATOR().

Read the general rules, then the affected backend, database or frontend pages. Written for Total.js 5 (`total5` on npm);

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/README.md): The zones, the pages and the principles
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/AGENTS.md): For an agent: how to use these pages and the rules that apply to every change
## General

- [Write and refactor workflow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/general/workflow.md): Select a reference, preserve contracts, correct code and verify behaviour
- [Native patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/general/native-patterns.md): Direct framework calls, existing helpers and execution context
- [Project structure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/general/project-structure.md): Native runtime folders, private inputs, internal docs/examples, entry point and move checks
- [JavaScript style](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/general/javascript-style.md): ES5 over ES6, prototypes and Tangular first, no imports from Node.js, formatting and names
- [Native tests and tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/general/testing.md): Direct total5/test bootstrap, suite config, disposable databases and visual verification
## Backend

- [Actions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/backend/actions.md): NEWACTION: naming with a pipe, input and params, answers, permissions, DATA
- [Standalone actions with tests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/backend/action-kits.md): Folder per action, contract, suite config, small samples, database integration, local-server tests and the checker
- [Routes and authentication](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/backend/routes-and-auth.md): ROUTE syntax for APIs, pages and uploads, and the single AUTH
- [Definitions and modules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/backend/definitions-and-modules.md): auth, init, func and db, config, automatic MODS loading, lifecycle and standalone-tool boundaries
- [Storage and integrations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/backend/storage-and-integrations.md): Existing persistence, RESTBuilder, configuration and lifecycle
- [Gotchas of the server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/backend/gotchas.md): Behaviours that differ from what you would guess
## Database

- [SQL scripts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/database/sql-scripts.md): PostgreSQL files, names, columns, order of the columns, code lists
- [Queries with DATA](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/database/queries.md): read, find, autoquery, insert, modify, remove, conditions, raw SQL
## Frontend

- [Components](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/frontend/components.md): Use the existing jComponent components, preferred ones, exec, intranetcss, COMPONENTATOR()
- [Plugins with UI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/frontend/plugins-ui.md): Server part, screens, forms, PLUGIN() and tapi
- [Views and layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/frontend/views-and-layout.md): The layout, directives, translations, public pages
- [Binding and forms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/frontend/binding-and-forms.md): Connected screen/importer/form flow, binding, translations and lifecycle
- [CMS widgets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/frontend/cms-widgets.md): Native single-file format, metadata, settings, scoped CSS, rendering and previews
- [CSS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/frontend/css.md): Formatting, CLASS scoping, predefined classes
